Annotators perform binary sentiment classification to assess label consistency and assign a naturality score from 1 (machine generated) to 3 (human written).

For each adversarial example and original input, we ask three workers to choose a sentiment label from "Positive" and "Negative" for it and annotate its naturality score from {1, 2, 3}, which indicates "Machine generated", "Not sure" and "Human written" respectively.
